Human system: Lattice instrument integration service, Instrument Hearth. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Interface Lending supplies translation around an incompatible process instead of immediately rewriting it.
The haven remains functioning and becomes a proposed receiving site for fragments whose original execution context is missing. Some adapters work; others only conceal incompatible assumptions.
Borrowing can enable a distinct continuity or help form a new one. The evidence need not settle which occurred.
